out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: Observed tooth brush store in cups stored in such a way that they could contaminate slicer in the prep area.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. CFM removed tooth brushes

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, 4 Hour Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed knives at the front, utensils in the fryer and coffee pots located at the front that are not being cleaned at least every 4 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils must be cleaned and sanitized at least every 4 hours to prevent contamination by bacterial growth. CFM sent utensils to wash, rinse and sanitize.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: observed cooked potato from Saturday 4/ 25 not being date marked
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CFM marked with the preparation date

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: Observed egg cartons use to store cooked bacon.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. CFM will remove bacon from egg cartons and will use food approved containers to store the bacon

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Designated Storage for Clothing, Possessions
violations.observation: Observed employee clothing and other possessions stored in areas that may contaminate food, food-contact surfaces of equipment, single-service items, or single- use items. Observed flats in dry storage next to the oil, and glasses with toothbrushes placed on top of the slicer
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated lockers and clothes hooks to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. CFM will designate a place to store employees and owners belongings

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a warewashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. PIC instructed all staff on proper hand washing locations at designated hand washing sinks.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: everything bagel at front service area.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. PIC discarded bagel and trained all staff.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the front service area being used to store knife
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC removed knife from hand sink and properly cleaned in at the three compartment sink.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticides
violations.observation: Restricted use pesticides do not meet the requirements in 40 CFR 152 Subpart 1 Classification of Pesticides. Observed “HOT SHOT” on mechanical box at back of kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Restricted use pesticides that do not meet the requirements of 40 CFR 152 may be toxic, which may result in the contamination of food. These pesticides shall not be used. PIC discarded residential use pesticide.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Adequate methods are not being used to control pests. Observed rodent droppings throughout back storage spaces and nonfood contact surfaces of kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PIC provided invoice from pest control service received on 9/17. A follow-up will be conducted within 10 days to ensure that an additional treatment is received.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: walls and the top and sides of hood system at back kitchen storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. A follow-up inspection will be conducted within 10 days.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the ceiling tiles above walk in freezer, tiles around ventilation ducts, and tiles above water heater are not maintained in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. A follow-up inspection will be conducted within 10 days to ensure completion of repair. MORNING BAGEL BAKERY (Inspection Date: 10/03/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Walk in refrigerator
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CFM changed the current crate to a dunnage rack with wheels.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the walls and floors in the kitchen area are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.
